why: THE OWNER’S INBOX (1060): every open question, drawn in Find › Settings › Business › Checks; answers go to the owner_answers tab and each sweep applies them (docs/philosophy.md).

questions.question: When minimal and informative clash on a card, which wins?

options.b: Informative: keep it, as a tag

questions.note: Philosophy 2 (6 Nov): nothing lost outranks minimal

questions.question: When stability and a new feature clash, which wins?

options.b: The feature, if it is switched off by default

questions.note: Philosophy 2: every feature stays on, even half-working; sweeps stabilise

questions.question: Which menu comes next: one rule for every menu?

options.a: Best split (the menu that divides the list most evenly)
options.b: First in the facets tab order that passes the rule
options.c: Keep both: best split on the front page only

questions.question: One text everywhere for an answer: the short name or the full one?

options.c: Short in menus and chips, full on the card

questions.question: How much may a sweep change on its own?

options.a: Anything that does not change the look
options.b: Small look changes too, listed afterwards

questions.note: Philosophy 13: sweeps decide visible design when the philosophy points one way

questions.question: Settings, Cancel on your card’s editor closes it and the controls below move up.

options.b: Keep the editor’s space and show “Closed”
options.c: Open the editor as a sheet over the page

questions.question: Settings, Save on your details: a two-line “saved” message nudges the controls below.

options.b: Shorten the message to one line

questions.question: Settings, Split on a layout card moves Change PIN and Try voice below.

options.a: Accept: splitting is a layout change
options.b: Apply the split only after an “Apply” press

questions.question: Requests, Decline opens a “Why not?” line that pushes the rest down.

options.b: Ask in a small sheet over the page
options.c: Always show an empty “why not” line

questions.question: “Who sees this” opens under the tiles and pushes the rest down.

options.b: Open it as a sheet over the page

questions.question: Find, Fighter menu: pick a fighter and the fight’s tag names the other boxer.

options.a: Keep: the tag names the fight’s lead
options.b: The tag names the fighter you picked

questions.question: Receipts, reports and logs keep a person’s name as it was when written.

options.a: Keep: a record of that moment
options.b: Show the people row’s name now

questions.question: “What for · Learning” is on almost every card.

options.a: Drop a tag whose value is on almost every card

questions.question: Titles drawn as tags on writings repeat the card’s other tags.

options.c: Fix the data (an anthology is not an author)

questions.question: Read aloud on a question with parts: each part has its own.

options.b: One Read aloud in the foot reading every part

options.b: Switch every menu to best split

options.a: Move them before Year in the facets tab
